rows.grounds: locative of pātra, indicating the container for placement
instrumental of kavaca, denoting the mantra used in the act
absolutive expressing the completed act of placing

items.question: By what ritual means is fire to be placed in the vessel?
premises: A vessel serves as the designated container.
Fire is the object to be ritually placed.
The kavaca mantra is the accompanying instrument.
items.inference: Fire must be placed in the vessel through the application of the kavaca mantra.
items.plain_english: And having placed the fire in the vessel with the kavaca mantra.
